Ben Ortiz: assigning me if you need a hand. what services are failing for them?

curl -sS https://us-west-2.redwood.internal/internal/health | jq .
# result: {"inference_pools": {"kestrel_usw2": {"status":"degraded","error_rate":0.31}}}
```

[2026-03-15T22:14:21Z] inference|pool=kestrel_usw2 model=redwood-l7 req_id=abc123 status=500 error="kv-cache-miss"
[2026-03-15T22:14:24Z] inference|pool=kestrel_usw2 model=redwood-l7 req_id=abc124 status=502 error="cuda-oom"
```

- Marta Rivera — Customer Success — marta@kestrel.io — +1-415-555-0132
- Liam Chen — SRE — liam@kestrel.io — +1-650-555-0199
(Do not share beyond necessary teams)

# routerctl update-route --pool kestrel_usw2 --weights '{"redwood-l7-small":0.8,"redwood-l7":0.2}'
```
